shortDescription: Manages a DTC HTTP Health Check

options.name: check_response_body
options.description: Optional. Flag which enables checking of the HTTP response body content. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: check_response_body_negative
options.description: Optional. Flag which changes the meaning of the regex match result. If set to I(true), the response is valid if regular expression matches not found. Defaults to I(false). The flag is currently not supported.

options.name: check_response_body_regex
options.description: Optional. Regular expression to search for a string in the HTTP response body. Error if empty while I(check_response_body) is I(true). Defaults to empty.

options.name: check_response_header
options.description: Optional. Flag which enables checking of the HTTP response header(s) content. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: check_response_header_negative
options.description: Optional. Flag which changes the meaning of the header regexes match result. If set to I(true), neither expression matches must be found in their respective headers for the headers to be considered valid. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: check_response_header_regexes
options.description: Optional. List of (header, regular expression) pairs. All expression matches must be found in their respective headers for the headers to be considered valid. Error if empty while I(check_response_header) is I(true). Defaults to empty.

options.name: codes
options.description: Optional. Response Status Codes meaning the health check is successful. If empty, any code means success. Individual codes and code ranges are supported, ex. "102,105-107,109-110,120".

options.name: comment
options.description: Optional. Comment for B(HTTPHealthCheck).

options.name: disabled
options.description: Optional. Flag which enables/disables B(HTTPHealthCheck). Defaults to I(false).

options.name: https
options.description: Optional. Flag which enables Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure (HTTPS) in a health check. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the object

options.name: interval
options.description: Optional. Interval value in seconds. The health check runs only for the specified interval and it is measured from the beginning of the previous check cycle. Defaults to I(15).

options.name: name
options.description: Display name of B(HTTPHealthCheck).

options.name: port
options.description: Destination TCP port of B(HTTPHealthCheck).

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: request
options.description: HTTP request in a text format, it consists of HTTP method, request target, HTTP headers, request body.

options.name: retry_down
options.description: Optional. Retry down count. The value determines how many bad health checks in a row must be received by the onprem host from the DTC Server for treating the health check as failed. Defaults to I(1).

options.name: retry_up
options.description: Optional. Retry up count. The value determines how many good health checks in a row must be received by the onprem host from the DTC Server for treating the health check as successful. Defaults to I(1).

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: tags
options.description: Optional. The tags for B(HTTPHealthCheck) in JSON format.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Optional. Timeout value in seconds. The health check waits for the specified number of seconds after sending a request. If it does not receive a response within the number of seconds, then the health check is considered as failed. Defaults to I(10).
